title: Events
description: Plan events, schedule them and publish them to the calendar.
newDescription: Saved as a draft first; it appears in the calendar once it is published.
emptyHint: Plan the first one; it stays a draft until you publish it.

end.label: Ends
end.hint: Optional. A time alone ends on the start day.
end.allDayHint: Optional; empty for a one-day event.

rsvpEnabled.label: Ask for responses
rsvpEnabled.hint: Turning it off keeps the answers given so far and hides the response buttons.

departments.label: Notify departments
departments.hint: Every event is visible to everyone in the calendar. Only the chosen departments are notified; none chosen: everyone.
